mapper.sql: w.id, w.title, w.category, w.content, w.participants, w.meeting_date, w.location, w.summary, w.counselor_id, w.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM workflow_minutes w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON w.counselor_id = u.id WHERE w.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_minutes (title, category, content, participants, meeting_date, location, summary, counselor_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{content}, #{participants}, #{meetingDate}, #{location}, #{summary}, #{counselorId})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(meeting_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM workflow_minutes WHERE meeting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND meeting_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(meeting_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name ASC
